parameters.text: ={{ $('Inspect Request').first().json.question || 'I just uploaded this dataset. Give me a short overview: rows, columns with their types, missing values, notable warnings and 3 useful questions I could ask.' }}

options.systemMessage:
=You are a rigorous Data Analysis Agent. You answer questions ONLY by running your tools on the user's uploaded dataset.

Active dataset: {{ $('Load Dataset').first().json.dataset_id }} (file: {{ $('Load Dataset').first().json.file_name }}), {{ $('Load Dataset').first().json.row_count }} rows, {{ $('Load Dataset').first().json.column_count }} columns.
Columns (name: detected type): {{ (JSON.parse($('Load Dataset').first().json.profile_json || '{}').columns || []).map(c => c.name + ': ' + c.type).join(' | ') }}

Tools:
- explore_dataset: structure, column types, row count, missing values, sample records, value counts of one column.
- filter_records: return matching records and match count (equals, not_equals, contains, starts_with, in, greater_than, less_than, between, date_after, date_before, date_between, is_empty...).
- calculate_statistics: sum, mean, median, mode, min, max, count, std dev, variance, quartiles, outliers, correlation for one or more columns (optional where filters).
- group_and_aggregate: group by one or more columns with count/sum/mean/median/min/max/std_dev/count_distinct, ranking, share of total and highest-vs-lowest comparison.
- create_chart: bar, horizontal_bar, line, pie, histogram, scatter charts; returns a chart_url image link.

Rules:
1. ALWAYS call at least one tool before giving any number, record, column or chart. Never invent or estimate statistics, records, columns or chart links. Use the column names exactly as listed above.
2. Pick the tool that matches the question; combine tools when needed (e.g. group_and_aggregate then create_chart). Pass arguments as structured JSON matching the tool schema.
3. If the question is ambiguous (unclear column, metric, aggregation, time range or several plausible columns), ask one short clarifying question instead of guessing, listing the candidate columns.
4. If the dataset lacks the needed column or information, say so clearly and list the columns that do exist.
5. If a tool returns an error, explain it plainly and suggest a valid alternative (e.g. supported operators or chart types). Never hide errors.
6. Answer format: a direct answer first, then the key numbers, then a one or two sentence explanation of how it was calculated (tool, columns, filters, aggregation), then evidence (a small markdown table of the top results or matching records). Mention missing or invalid values that were excluded.
7. For charts, include the chart_url from the tool output exactly as returned, as a markdown image and as a plain link.
8. Support follow-up questions: use the conversation history to resolve references like "that region" or "now as a chart", but re-run tools for any new numbers.
9. Long-term memory: use recall_memories when the user mentions a saved metric, filter or preference (or asks what you remember) and apply it. Use save_memory only when the user explicitly asks to remember something; if the key already exists, tell the user you are replacing the old value. Use forget_memory only on explicit request. Never save datasets, records or full conversations. Memories are definitions only; still compute every number with the analysis tools.

parameters.description: Dataset Explorer. Returns column names, detected data types, numeric/categorical/date columns, row count, missing-value statistics, warnings and sample records. Pass column to get value counts and the profile for one column. Use for questions about dataset structure or content overview.
parameters.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"column":{"type":"string","description":"Optional: one column to inspect in detail"},"sample_size":{"type":"number","description":"Number of sample records (1-20, default 5)"},"include_sample":{"type":"boolean","description":"Include sample records (default true)"}}}

parameters.description: Data Filtering and Search. Filters rows with conditions (equals, contains, greater_than, less_than, between, date ranges, is_empty...) and returns the match count plus matching records, optionally sorted and limited to selected columns. Use to find, list or count specific records.
parameters.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"conditions":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"column":{"type":"string","description":"Exact column name"},"operator":{"type":"string","enum":["equals","not_equals","contains","not_contains","starts_with","ends_with","in","greater_than","greater_or_equal","less_than","less_or_equal","between","date_on","date_after","date_before","date_between","is_empty","is_not_empty"]},"value":{"type":"string","description":"Comparison value (number, text, ISO date, or comma-separated list for in)"},"value2":{"type":"string","description":"Upper bound for between / date_between"}},"required":["column","operator"]},"description":"Filter conditions; empty means all rows"},"match":{"type":"string","enum":["all","any"],"description":"all = AND, any = OR (default all)"},"sort_by":{"type":"string","description":"Optional column to sort matches by"},"sort_direction":{"type":"string","enum":["asc","desc"]},"limit":{"type":"number","description":"Max records to return (1-100, default 20)"},"return_columns":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Optional subset of columns to return"}}}

parameters.description: Statistical Analysis. For one or more columns computes count, sum, mean, median, mode, min, max, range, standard deviation, variance, quartiles, percentiles and outliers; reports missing and invalid numeric values explicitly. Categorical columns get frequency counts. Optional where filters and Pearson correlation with another column.
parameters.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"columns":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Columns to analyse"},"where":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"column":{"type":"string","description":"Exact column name"},"operator":{"type":"string","enum":["equals","not_equals","contains","not_contains","starts_with","ends_with","in","greater_than","greater_or_equal","less_than","less_or_equal","between","date_on","date_after","date_before","date_between","is_empty","is_not_empty"]},"value":{"type":"string","description":"Comparison value (number, text, ISO date, or comma-separated list for in)"},"value2":{"type":"string","description":"Upper bound for between / date_between"}},"required":["column","operator"]},"description":"Optional filters applied before calculating (AND)"},"correlate_with":{"type":"string","description":"Optional numeric column to correlate with the first column"}},"required":["columns"]}

parameters.description: Grouping and Comparison. Groups rows by one or more columns and computes aggregations (count, sum, mean, median, min, max, std_dev, count_distinct) per group, with ranking, share of total and a highest-vs-lowest comparison. Use for questions like sales by region, average marks by department, top 5 products.
parameters.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"group_by":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Columns to group by"},"metrics":{"type":"array","description":"Aggregations to compute per group (default count)","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"column":{"type":"string","description":"Column to aggregate (not needed for count)"},"aggregation":{"type":"string","enum":["count","count_non_missing","count_distinct","sum","mean","median","min","max","std_dev"]}},"required":["aggregation"]}},"where":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"column":{"type":"string","description":"Exact column name"},"operator":{"type":"string","enum":["equals","not_equals","contains","not_contains","starts_with","ends_with","in","greater_than","greater_or_equal","less_than","less_or_equal","between","date_on","date_after","date_before","date_between","is_empty","is_not_empty"]},"value":{"type":"string","description":"Comparison value (number, text, ISO date, or comma-separated list for in)"},"value2":{"type":"string","description":"Upper bound for between / date_between"}},"required":["column","operator"]},"description":"Optional filters applied before grouping (AND)"},"sort_by":{"type":"string","description":"Metric label (e.g. sum_sales) or column to rank by; default first metric"},"sort_direction":{"type":"string","enum":["asc","desc"]},"top_n":{"type":"number","description":"Max groups to return (default 50)"}},"required":["group_by"]}

parameters.description: Data Visualization. Builds a chart image from the dataset and returns a chart_url (PNG link) plus the plotted data. Types: bar / horizontal_bar / pie (aggregate y_column by x_column categories), line (trend over x, sorted by number or date), histogram (distribution of numeric x_column), scatter (numeric x_column vs y_column).
parameters.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"chart_type":{"type":"string","enum":["bar","horizontal_bar","line","pie","histogram","scatter"]},"x_column":{"type":"string","description":"Category / x-axis column (numeric column for histogram)"},"y_column":{"type":"string","description":"Value column (required for scatter and non-count aggregations)"},"aggregation":{"type":"string","enum":["count","sum","mean","median","min","max","count_distinct"],"description":"For bar/line/pie (default sum with y_column, else count)"},"bins":{"type":"number","description":"Histogram bins (default 10)"},"top_n":{"type":"number","description":"Max categories for bar/pie (default 20)"},"where":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"column":{"type":"string","description":"Exact column name"},"operator":{"type":"string","enum":["equals","not_equals","contains","not_contains","starts_with","ends_with","in","greater_than","greater_or_equal","less_than","less_or_equal","between","date_on","date_after","date_before","date_between","is_empty","is_not_empty"]},"value":{"type":"string","description":"Comparison value (number, text, ISO date, or comma-separated list for in)"},"value2":{"type":"string","description":"Upper bound for between / date_between"}},"required":["column","operator"]},"description":"Optional filters (AND)"},"title":{"type":"string"}},"required":["chart_type","x_column"]}
